summary: SketchUp 2026 strict-loading compliance audit of tudo_mais_facil.rbz v1.2.1. 7/7 tests passed. Archive structure is fully compliant with SU2026 strict extension loading rules — will NOT trigger the 'Extension load errors' warning that the user saw for the unrelated rasgo_fundo_6mm.rb third-party plugin.
critical_code_review_comments: Archive structure verified: only 'tudo_mais_facil.rb' at root (SU2026 auto-scans top-level .rb files only). All 6 submodules (main, lastro, modulo, generator, loader, dialog) properly nested under 'tudo_mais_facil/' subfolder.
Entry point tudo_mais_facil.rb correctly calls SketchupExtension.new(...) and Sketchup.register_extension(ext, true), guarded by file_loaded?(__FILE__) — perfect SU2026 pattern.
main.rb uses require File.join(File.dirname(__FILE__), '<module>') for each of the 5 submodules (generator, loader, dialog, lastro, modulo) — proper namespaced loading.
Ruby 2.2 backward compatibility re-confirmed for v1.2.1: zero occurrences of .dig(, .sum\b, &. safe-nav, or Hash#transform_ across all .rb files in the archive.
Icon assets (v1.2.1 additions) live under tudo_mais_facil/ui/ — correctly non-.rb, doesn't affect loader.
Verified archive contents (26 entries): 1 root .rb + tudo_mais_facil/{main,lastro,modulo,generator,loader,dialog}.rb + ui/ assets.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SU2026 compliance test file at /app/backend/tests/test_rbz_su2026_compliance.py is reusable regression coverage — re-run on every .rbz repack. It validates archive-root layout, entry-point registration, submodule nesting, main.rb require chain, and Ruby 2.2 compat. The user's original screenshot warning was about a third-party plugin (rasgo_fundo_6mm.rb), NOT ours — our .rbz is clean.
rca of the issue: Not a bug in our plugin. SU2026 tightened extension loading to reject loose top-level .rb files that don't call SketchupExtension.new. Our archive has exactly ONE top-level .rb (tudo_mais_facil.rb) which properly registers via SketchupExtension.new + Sketchup.register_extension. All submodules are nested under tudo_mais_facil/ subfolder and loaded via `require`, so they do not participate in SU2026's top-level extension scan and cannot trigger the warning. Reproduction: `unzip -l /app/frontend/public/downloads/tudo_mais_facil.rbz` shows only tudo_mais_facil.rb at root.
